title: GET /_status/series response
description: Single source of truth for series_response()'s shape in status.py. `data` restates no shape of its own -- it $refs status_payload.schema.json's own Reliability/HostMetrics/Assistant/PanelError defs by relative path, since a panned single-range payload is exactly one of those subtrees, never a new one. Kept alongside status_payload.schema.json and excluded from the Lambda zip the same way (archive_file's explicit source list in main.tf). TS types generated via npm run codegen; a pre-commit hook validates fixtures under build/web/tests/fixtures/series/ against this file. No $id, unlike status_payload.schema.json's -- an $id here would win over this file's own retrieval location as the base URI for its relative $refs (per the JSON Schema spec's own precedence, not a check-jsonschema quirk), making the sibling-file $refs unresolvable everywhere but this repo's absolute local path.

end.description: iso(end) -- the requested end, echoed back after clamping/parsing.
